summary: The recorded base reproduced the original shared eager fixed-width verification defect: TP-only padding produced incomplete request groups (228 -> 232 for B=38,D=6,A=8 and 198 -> 200 for B=33). Exact candidate f32316b aligns fixed-width hybrid target verification to lcm(attention TP size, tokens per request) before DP padding selection and makes fabricated dummy requests state-free with initialized output rows in the affected Triton convolution, recurrent GDN, and opt-in fused KDA kernels. Candidate and independent tests passed. This is a correct partial fix, not a complete resolution of the original issue, because the separate GLM DSA KPool real-request planning boundary remains outside this PR.

tests.what_was_measured: Issue-specific failing-before behavior on exact base: 3 test methods failed, with failing subtests including B=33 (198 -> 200 instead of 216), B=38 (228 -> 232 instead of 240), and incorrect DP MAX_LEN/SUM_LEN group boundaries.
All 17 candidate GPU regressions failed before the patch, including deterministic NaN evidence for uninitialized dummy outputs and dummy-request state/metadata safety failures.
5 tests and 7 subtests passed: original B33/B38 geometry, B36/B39 controls, output-domain restoration, DP MAX_LEN/SUM_LEN active and idle ranks, and non-hybrid/ragged controls.

17 tests passed on one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950. Real rows matched independently executed unpadded references; dummy outputs were zero; persistent and intermediate state remained unchanged across convolution, recurrent GDN, and fused KDA paths.

51 independent adversarial cases passed across TP sizes 1/3/4/7/8/16, request widths 1/5/6/7/8, batch sizes 0/1/2/17/33/38/39/65, and DP token domains; every physical count remained divisible by both TP and fixed request width.

remaining_counterexamples: GLM-5.3-Flash with DSA KPool still requires the separate real-request writer/read planning correction in upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37588; PR 993 does not modify dsa_indexer_kpool.py and therefore cannot fully resolve that original-issue path.
remaining_limitations: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B and GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, so no full model or HTTP serving workload was run.
Only one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 was available; the reported 8x NVIDIA H20 TP8/EP8 CUDA 13 environment and multi-rank collective execution were not reproduced.
The focused tests validate layout, dummy-output initialization, and state ownership, not model semantic accuracy or universal backend coverage.
No native C/C++/HIP/FlyDSL source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
